name: MiniMax-M2-REAP-139B-A10B
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M2 (config.json max_position_embeddings 204800). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: GQA, all-full attention (attn_type_list all 1; M2 line abandoned M1's hybrid lightning attention)
notes: ADDED 2026-10-30. A one-shot expert-pruned compression of MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M2, not a new base model and not a quant: uniform REAP pruning removed 40%% of experts, 256 -> 154 per layer, taking the model from 229B to 139.1B total (10B active, 8 of 154 routed). Config is otherwise the base's. Recorded because the card prints a column for both models in one table; it is a memory/quality trade-off, not a capability gain - 7 of its 8 eval columns lose to the base. Licence 'other' (modified MIT), repo created 2025-11-17.

benchmarks.name: MATH-500
benchmarks.config: Card HTML eval table, column 'MiniMax-M2-REAP-139B-A10B' vs 'MiniMax-M2': 93.8 vs 91.6. Only column of eight this checkpoint wins - HumanEval 91.5/93.9, HumanEval+ 83.5/89.0, MBPP 85.2/87.6, MBPP+ 71.4/73.0, AIME25 73.3/76.7, tau2-bench 55.3/59.1, BFCLv3 57.9/62.6 all lose. 40% uniform expert pruning (256->154 experts), 139B total / 10B active, one-shot, no fine-tuning. Recorded as a compression trade-off, not a capability gain.
